preconditions.description: The number of rows n is between 1 and 5 inclusive.
The number of columns m is between 1 and 20 inclusive.
The length of the list a is equal to the number of rows n.
The length of the list b is equal to the number of columns m.

postconditions.expression: all(len(row) == m for row in return_value.split('\n'))
postconditions.description: Each row in the output has exactly m characters.

postconditions.expression: all(char in '.*' for row in return_value.split('\n') for char in row)
postconditions.description: Each character in the output is either '.' or '*'.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(1 for char in row if char == '*') == ai for ai, row in zip(a, return_value.split('\n')))
postconditions.description: The number of contiguous black segments in each row matches the corresponding value in a.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(1 for char in col if char == '*') == bi for bi, col in zip(b, [''.join(row[i] for row in return_value.split('\n')) for i in range(m)]))
postconditions.description: The number of contiguous black segments in each column matches the corresponding value in b.
